purpose: Leave-one-session-out magnetic sequence localization; labels never enter matching.
method: Per detected step, median magnetic magnitude since the previous step.
Query windows are disjoint and reset after a gap over 3 seconds; training windows advance by 2 steps.
Train candidates come only from other sessions in the same direction.
Candidates are limited to 12 m around current PDR, because magnetic correction is local support rather than global positioning.
Acceptance uses the existing score <= 0.5 and alternative-location margin >= 0.08 thresholds.
For 3 steps only, the same z-normalized squared distance is used without DTW because the current matcher rejects windows shorter than 5.
A 25% move toward the accepted candidate is a diagnostic thought experiment, not current particle behavior.
limitations: Step truth is linearly interpolated between manually pressed room labels; it is weak timing truth, not surveyed foot position.
The same user/device/building is used across folds.
Multiple overlapping windows from one walk are correlated and must not be read as independent trials.
Thresholds were not retuned on these results.
